note: Step 2 (C(n, k) and Pascal rows) is attached to the existing counting-permutations concept.

description.zh: 每个大于 1 的整数都能唯一地写成质数幂的乘积，就像它的骨架；指数还直接告诉你它有多少个正因数，比如 12 = 2²·3 有 (2+1)(1+1) = 6 个。
description.en: Every whole number greater than 1 can be written in exactly one way as a product of prime powers — its skeleton; the exponents even tell how many divisors it has: 12 = 2²·3 has (2+1)(1+1) = 6.

title.zh: 最大公因数与辗转相除法

description.zh: 求两个数的最大公因数不必试遍所有因数：用大数除以小数取余数，再用除数除以余数，反复下去，最后一个非零余数就是最大公因数；最小公倍数等于两数之积除以它。
description.en: To find the greatest common divisor of two numbers you need not try every factor: divide the larger by the smaller and keep the remainder, divide the divisor by that remainder, and repeat — the last nonzero remainder is the gcd, and the least common multiple is the product divided by it.

nodes.formula: gcd(a, b) = gcd(b, a mod b)

label.zh: 两条路找同一个公因数
label.en: Two roads to the same common divisor

reason.zh: 最大公因数可以取两数共有质因数的最低次幂，也可以用余数链求出；数太大难以分解时，余数链要快得多。
reason.en: The gcd can be read off as the shared prime powers at their lowest exponents, or found by the remainder chain; when the numbers are too big to factor, the remainder chain is far faster.

label.en: Easy to multiply, hard to factor

reason.zh: 两个大质数相乘一瞬间，把乘积分解回去却极慢；RSA 公开乘积 n = pq 作为公钥，安全就建立在没人能及时把它分解开。
reason.en: Multiplying two large primes is instant but factoring the product back is extremely slow; RSA publishes n = pq as its public key, and its security rests on nobody being able to factor it in time.

label.zh: 扩展欧几里得算出私钥
label.en: Extended Euclid computes the private key

reason.zh: RSA 的私钥 d 要满足 e·d 除以 φ(n) 余 1；把辗转相除的过程倒推回去（扩展欧几里得算法），就能算出这个 d。
reason.en: RSA’s private key d must leave remainder 1 when e·d is divided by φ(n); running the remainder chain backwards — the extended Euclidean algorithm — produces that d.
